newsitem.title: USA: Seibels buys N.C. insurance company.
newsitem.headline: Seibels buys N.C. insurance company.

text.p: Seibels Bruce Group Inc said Friday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire The Innovative Co, an insurance holding company.

Under the deal, Seibels Bruce is to acquire all of the outstanding capital stock of Innovative. Seibels Bruce also will issue 220,000 shares of convertible non-voting preferred stock with a liquidation value of $10.00 per share, it said.

The special stock will, subject to certain conditions, be convertible into 275,000 shares of Seibels Bruce common stock and be redeemable by Seibels Bruce at a premium beginning on August 15, 2000, it said.
In addition, Seibels Bruce will pay off about $1.8 million of indebtedness at the time of the closing and pay a purchase price adjustment in cash not to exceed $400,000.
The Innovative Co, through its subsidiary Universal Insurance Co, markets and underwrites non-standard automobile insurance through independent agents primarily in North Carolina.

The acquisition is expected to facilitate the expansion of Seibels Bruce's retained risk automobile insurance business in North Carolina and provide it with access to a larger group of independent agents in North Carolina, the company said.

The completion of the acquisition is subject to a number of conditions, including the receipt of certain regulatory approvals. The company said there can be no assurance that the transaction will ultimately close.
